notes.text: Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus, known in English as Pompey or Pompey the Great, was a Roman general and statesman who was prominent in the final decades of the Roman Republic.
Pompey is remembered as a politician connected with Italy.
Pompey's recorded life dates place this profile around -106--48.
Pompey is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
Pompey's profile connects a short Fact to a wider Italy historical setting.
